profile.details: The system correctly extracted core profile information (user_email, user_name, signature details, formal tone, French language, no emoji/first names). However, it used a different schema for greeting/closing styles (generic 'formal_fr' vs specific 'formal_fr_client/lawyer/colleague'), losing important context about relationship-based tone variation. Active hours (09:00-14:30 vs 09:00-19:30) and response time (< 2h vs < 4h) are significantly incorrect, which could mislead email scheduling. The schema includes extra null fields (signature_en, casual styles) not in ground truth.

rules.details: The system captured 9/10 contact rules (90%) but with several errors in tone classification and closings. It found 8/8 general rules conceptually but reformulated them significantly, changing names and sometimes meanings. The system hallucinated forbidden_phrases and auto_reply_patterns that don't exist in ground truth. Major issues: incorrect tone classifications (e.fontaine and m.leroux marked 'semi-formal' instead of 'formal'), wrong closings (n.vernier got 'Cordialement' instead of full formula, d.perrin got 'Cordialement' instead of full formula, jl.garnier got wrong formula variant, h.castellan has minor wording difference). General rules were restructured with different names and some conceptual drift (e.g., 'tutoiement_equipe' contradicts the vouvoiement rule). The fabricated forbidden_phrases and auto_reply_patterns reduce precision significantly.
